text: This report recommends that the name "Antonio Lopes Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of Gladstone Avenue, extending between Argyle Street and Cross Street. Community Council have delegated authority to decide lane naming matters which comply with The City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Antonio Lopes Lane" for an existing public lane located east of Gladstone Avenue extending between Argyle Street and Cross Street.
